voice.name: George
voice.note: young male, Northern English — Ritson, North East investigator, recalling ~15 years on

segments.s_open: I watched a carving knife throw itself across the kitchen. It bounced off the television and hit the floor. Nobody was near it. [pause] I was there to take notes.
segments.s_s1: A young couple, and a little lad. An ordinary house in South Shields. They said things were moving. [soft laugh] Things are never moving — it's pipes, it's drafts, it's somebody wanting attention. I'd seen dozens of these. So we stayed. Two of us, month after month, cameras in every room. Five hundred photographs. Hours of tape.
segments.s_s2: A plastic nut off the boy's toy bench — it flew across the room. Not fell. Flew, with force, off a cupboard door. A rubber ball appeared on the bed from nowhere — I picked it up, and it was hot. Like it had been held. [pause] And the whole time, our eyes were on that couple. Their hands. Every minute of every night. It was not them. I can say that with one hundred percent certainty.
segments.s_s3: Then the knives. I found a kitchen knife lying in the middle of the boy's bedroom floor — it had not been there minutes before. Then the carving knife, in front of me, across the kitchen. [pause] And Marc's back... his back opened up. Long scratches, through his shirt, while we were in the house. Nobody within reach of him.
segments.s_s4: The little one had a doodle board — a child's toy, you write on it and wipe it clean. Words started appearing on it. 'Go now.' 'Stop it now.' In nobody's handwriting. [pause] Then her phone. Messages — going to die today, going to get you. I'll come for you when you're asleep. We checked the phones they came from. [exhales] They were switched off.
segments.s_s5: That's nearly twenty years ago now. I've been called gullible, and worse — I've heard it all. We were two grown men in a small house, watching everything, writing it down the day it happened. Every word of it stands. [pause] There is more to this world than we know at this moment. I can say that with total conviction. Make of it what you like.

small: The witness is a paranormal investigator.

yt_title: South Shields: The Knife That Threw Itself
